purpose: Predeclared repair factorial and fixed-SO cooperation diagnosis
classic_calibration: None; NSGA2_4V setting0 locked before runs
fe_role: Diagnostic; censored checkpoints stay null and empty

semantic_contract.S: Snapshot global-post N before local search; pool global-post then local-post (2N records), one whole-pool PDDR; no initial parents
semantic_contract.stable_ties: Original candidate order; global-post block before local-post; no new diversity tie-break
semantic_contract.O: Per guide six independent pre-drawn triggers; three closed segments; FA event always redraws MA/WA; invalid resources uniformly redrawn
semantic_contract.segments: Two independent uniform endpoints0..N-1, equality allowed, sorted inclusive; donor read-only
semantic_contract.resource_sampling: Uniform valid identifiers; original value allowed; FA mutation draws position, factory, machine, worker in that order
semantic_contract.common_feasibility: Unchanged final SchedulingEncoding.repair; nonempty-factory rule/model/decoder/objectives unchanged
semantic_contract.cooperation: Whole200-pool PDDR scores then category truncation [free80,family0:5,family1:5,family2:5,family3:5] in both SYNC_FIX and SHARE_FIX
semantic_contract.history: Independent global snapshot; descend forks branch while retaining lineage; both branches may survive with separate ND personal histories
semantic_contract.diagnostics: All7 versions paid observer; distinctness after restore/repair sampled every256 global proposals; exact shared origins capped4096
semantic_contract.pool_capture: First2 and last immutable paid pools, at most3; reference/numeric capture insideT, full encoding export outsideT but within campaign cap

diagnostic_cost_boundary.auditSeconds: Search-internal bounded numeric/reference capture; included in each registered T
diagnostic_cost_boundary.poolExportSeconds: Post-search encoding/JSON materialization; offline cost, included in the original campaign wall cap
diagnostic_cost_boundary.wrapperWallSeconds: JVM startup, search, replay and export measured together; controller validation measured separately

metrics.igdplus_reference: Per-instance nondominated union of all7 variants x all5 seeds deadline-valid T archives; approximate, offline only
metrics.seed_aggregation: Mean of five repeats per instance; six instances are the paired units
metrics.practical_win: mean-HV effect >=1% and >=3/5 positive paired seed differences
metrics.practical_loss: mean-HV effect <=-1% and >=3/5 negative paired seed differences
metrics.interaction: HV_SO-HV_S_ONLY-HV_O_ONLY+HV_V2; seed percent uses that seed's V2 denominator

scope: Development repair evidence only; no original270 traffic-light decision and no step6 qualification
continuation_rule: Complete and correct factorial phase -> predeclared cooperation phase; never select by quality
historical_results: Context only; no historical outcomes enter metrics or timing comparisons
